# Lucky Numbers

> UK Lotto & EuroMillions number picker, statistics and slip organiser. For entertainment only — 18+. From Froggy Eye Ltd, a UK indie app studio.

## App information

- Category: Entertainment
- Studio: Froggy Eye Ltd ([https://froggyeye.com](https://froggyeye.com))
- Platforms: iOS, Android
- Price: Free, with a single one-time £4.99 "Pro" unlock (no subscription, no ads)
- Age rating: 18+ (lottery-adjacent content; in-app age gate)

## What it does

- Number generators: Lucky Dip (uniform random) plus hot/cold/balanced picks from frequency statistics, with lock/exclude controls
- Lucky Picks: four playful on-device pickers — a shake-the-phone ball machine, meaningful numbers (birthdays, names, dream symbols), a photo-entropy "lucky moment" picker, and a three-question lucky reading
- My Slips: save, name and organise number lines per game, stored only on-device
- Draw-day reminders via local notifications
- Offline results checker with indicative prize tiers
- Pro (one-time unlock): Strategy Lab — wheeling systems, coverage strategies, an honest cost & odds calculator, and a budget planner with a responsible-play nudge

## Important honesty notes

- The app does NOT sell lottery tickets, take wagers, or facilitate gambling
- Nothing in the app improves the odds of winning, and the app states this prominently
- No accounts, no analytics, no ads, no tracking; photos used by the "lucky moment" picker are processed once in memory and never stored or uploaded
- Responsible gambling signposting throughout: BeGambleAware.org and the GamCare National Gambling Helpline 0808 8020 133
- Not affiliated with the National Lottery, Allwyn/Camelot, or the EuroMillions operators
